verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows a Careers Site API that lists published jobs and accepts applications so you can build them into your own custom website (recruitee-docs-4, -3, -44, -36), plus XML job-board feeds of all published jobs (recruitee-docs-39). Jobs do flow from the ATS, but this route needs engineering work, which is exactly what the story wants to avoid. Missing for 10: evidence of a hosted careers page, branding/design customization, custom-domain support, a no-code publishing workflow, and independent corroboration.
